description: Sound effect descriptors for Rising Star Kid adaptive learning tasks. Each entry describes when and how to use the sound.

correct_chime.description: Short, bright chime played when child answers correctly
correct_chime.description_zh: 答对时播放的短促明亮铃声
correct_chime.notes: Should be encouraging but not overstimulating. Gentle bell or xylophone tone.

incorrect_gentle.description: Soft, non-punishing tone when answer is incorrect
incorrect_gentle.description_zh: 答错时播放的柔和提示音
incorrect_gentle.notes: Must be gentle and neutral. Avoid buzzer sounds that could cause anxiety.

try_again.description: Encouraging tone prompting child to try again
try_again.description_zh: 鼓励再试一次的提示音
try_again.notes: Uplifting, like a gentle nudge forward.

level_up.description: Celebratory sound when child advances to next level
level_up.notes: Joyful fanfare, not too loud. Stars/sparkle feeling.

session_complete.description: Warm completion sound at end of learning session
session_complete.description_zh: 学习会话结束时的温暖音效
session_complete.notes: Calming, satisfying resolution. Like a gentle musical phrase ending.

streak_bonus.description: Extra celebratory sound for correct answer streaks
streak_bonus.description_zh: 连续答对的额外庆祝音效

tap_select.description: Light tap sound when child selects an option
tap_select.description_zh: 选择选项时的轻触音效
tap_select.notes: Very subtle, like a soft click. Provides tactile feedback.

drag_start.description: Sound when starting to drag an item

drop_place.description: Sound when dropping/placing an item in target
drop_place.notes: Satisfying placement sound, like a soft thud.

card_flip.description: Sound when flipping a flashcard or revealing content

screen_transition.description: Soft swoosh when navigating between screens
screen_transition.description_zh: 切换页面时的柔和音效

menu_open.description: Sound when opening a menu or panel

animal_greeting.description: Friendly animal sound when assessment character appears
animal_greeting.description_zh: 评估角色出现时的友好动物叫声
animal_greeting.notes: Cute, non-threatening animal vocalization matching the guide character.

activity_intro.description: Playful sound introducing a new assessment activity
activity_intro.description_zh: 引入新评估活动时的活泼音效
activity_intro.notes: Musical phrase that signals 'here comes something new and fun'.

assessment_complete.description: Celebration sound when assessment journey finishes
assessment_complete.description_zh: 评估完成时的庆祝音效
assessment_complete.notes: Full celebration with gentle fanfare. Child should feel accomplished.

background_calm.description: Optional calming background music loop for sessions
background_calm.description_zh: 学习会话中的可选平静背景音乐
background_calm.notes: Very subtle, repetitive, calming. Can be toggled off in settings. Minimal melody.

nature_sounds.description: Optional nature ambient sounds (birds, water) for calm environment
nature_sounds.description_zh: 可选的自然环境音（鸟鸣、流水）
nature_sounds.notes: Alternative to music. Some ASD children prefer nature sounds.

listen_prompt.description: Tone indicating child should listen carefully
listen_prompt.description_zh: 提示孩子仔细听的音效
listen_prompt.notes: Attention-getting but gentle. Like a soft bell.

speak_prompt.description: Tone indicating child should speak/respond vocally
speak_prompt.description_zh: 提示孩子说话/口头回答的音效
speak_prompt.notes: Encouraging, like a gentle 'your turn' cue.

recording_start.notes: Clear but soft beep indicating recording is active.

recording_stop.notes: Double beep indicating recording has stopped.

general: All sounds should be gentle and non-startling for children with autism
Avoid sudden loud sounds, buzzer-like tones, or harsh frequencies
Keep sounds short (under 2s for feedback, under 1s for interactions)
Use warm, natural tones (bells, xylophones, soft synths)
Provide volume control and mute option in app settings
Consider sensory sensitivity - some children may need sounds completely off
design_guidelines.frequency_range: Focus on mid-range frequencies (300Hz-2000Hz). Avoid very high or very low frequencies.
design_guidelines.volume: Default volume should be moderate (60-70% of max). Allow user adjustment.
